purpose: A Vite plugin that makes one policy file the page's Content-Security-Policy meta tag, the header on the dev and preview servers, and the build's _headers file.

host.replaces: run-8 app/vite.config.ts: fakePolicy and withDevSocket (the fake-mode connect-src swap and the dev websocket)
run-8 app/vite.config.ts: the Studio-path test in headerFor and the index/fake html test in transformIndexHtml
run-8 app/vite.config.ts: the nosniff, referrer and permissions lines of _headers

library.title: CSP headers (one policy file to meta tag, dev header and _headers)
library.note: Vite plugin, Node only: reads one policy file (default security/csp.txt) and writes the Content-Security-Policy meta tag into index.html (without frame-ancestors, which a meta tag cannot carry), sets the header on the dev and preview servers, and writes or merges dist/_headers for Cloudflare Pages. Per-app parts come in as exclude and transformPolicy; the pure helpers readPolicy, metaPolicy, headersFileText need no Vite. Needs no vite package. Also found as: content security policy; CSP header; security headers; _headers file; Cloudflare headers; meta CSP.
